items.hed: Texans play Jacksonville in London on Sunday, 8:30 a.m. Central
items.insight: The Houston Texans schedule lists Sunday, Oct. 18, as an away game against the Jacksonville Jaguars at Wembley Stadium, kickoff 8:30 a.m. Central, on NFL Network, as part of the NFL International Series. No score is printed here because Sunday has not been played.

items.hed: Astros are out; Tampa Bay is at Cleveland tonight in Game 4
items.insight: MLB.com's postseason schedule lists Friday, Oct. 16, as Tampa Bay at Cleveland, Game 4, at 8 p.m. Eastern on TBS, truTV, HBO Max, and UniMas. Saturday's Game 5 is the same time and networks. The World Series schedule lists the Brewers as the National League side, with Game 1 on Friday, Oct. 23. Houston is not on the League Championship Series list. No series score is printed here because the Friday page did not carry one.

items.hed: Rockets open at home against Dallas on Oct. 21, 7:30 p.m.
items.insight: The Rockets' schedule announcement lists Opening Night against Dallas on Oct. 21, then San Antonio at Moody Center in Austin on Oct. 23. Standard home tipoff has moved from 7 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. The same release says Houston closed the preseason at home against Oklahoma City on Oct. 15. No regular-season score is printed here because the opener has not been played.
